products.title: Terracotta Leaf Plant
products.body_html:
A tall, airy houseplant in a classic pedestal urn. The Fernwork Terracotta Leaf Plant brings a bright, branching shape to entryways, living rooms and sunny corners.

Key Features

  • Branching stems with soft, lobed leaves
  • Footed terracotta urn with a timeless profile
  • Statement height that fills an empty corner

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: One plant, potted
  • Colour: Fresh green / Terracotta
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 95 cm; width: approximately 42 cm
  • Materials: Live houseplant in a fired-clay terracotta urn

Care Instructions

Place in bright, indirect light. Water when the top 2–3 cm of soil feels dry, and let excess drain away. Rotate a quarter turn each week for even growth.

What's Included

1 potted plant in a terracotta urn, care card

Placement & Usage Notes

Terracotta is porous and may leave a mark on delicate surfaces. Use a saucer or felt pad underneath.

products.title: Elephant Ear in Clay Pot
products.body_html:
Big, heart-shaped leaves with pale green veining. The Fernwork Elephant Ear in Clay Pot gives any room an instant tropical feel.

Key Features

  • Large, veined leaves that catch the light
  • Rounded clay pot with a warm, natural finish
  • Full, generous shape from day one

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: One plant, potted
  • Colour: Green / Terracotta
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 63 cm; width: approximately 53 cm
  • Materials: Live houseplant in a fired-clay pot

Care Instructions

Keep in bright, indirect light and out of cold drafts. Water when the top layer of soil is dry, and wipe the leaves now and then to keep them glossy.

What's Included

1 potted plant in a clay pot, care card

Placement & Usage Notes

Keep away from radiators and air-conditioning vents. Leaves are large, so allow some space around the pot.

products.title: Desert Aloe in Chalk Planter
products.body_html:
A compact, striped succulent in a matte chalk-white pot. The Fernwork Desert Aloe in Chalk Planter is the easiest green companion for desks, shelves and windowsills.

Key Features

  • Architectural rosette with crisp white banding
  • Matte chalk-white planter that suits any palette
  • Small enough for a shelf, desk or windowsill

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: One succulent, potted
  • Colour: Green / Chalk white
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 27 cm; width: approximately 19 cm
  • Materials: Live succulent in a matte ceramic planter

Care Instructions

Give it plenty of bright light, including some direct sun. Water deeply but only when the soil has dried out completely, usually every two to three weeks.

What's Included

1 potted succulent, care card

Placement & Usage Notes

The planter has no drainage hole. Water sparingly and tip out any excess after watering.

products.title: Hand-Thrown Terracotta Pot
products.body_html:
A weathered, hand-thrown pot with a softly flared rim. The Fernwork Hand-Thrown Terracotta Pot ages beautifully and is ready for herbs, succulents or a small leafy plant.

Key Features

  • Hand-thrown shape with a gently flared rim
  • Natural, weathered terracotta finish
  • Breathable clay helps roots stay healthy

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single pot
  • Colour: Terracotta
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 22 cm; top diameter: approximately 27 cm
  • Materials: Fired terracotta clay

Care Instructions

Soak briefly before first use. Wipe with a damp cloth to clean. Over time the surface will develop a natural patina.

What's Included

1 terracotta pot

Placement & Usage Notes

Each pot is slightly different, so small variations in shape and colour are normal. Use a saucer to protect surfaces.

products.title: Cream Pitcher Vase
products.body_html:
A soft, matte pitcher with a slim neck and a single curved handle. The Fernwork Cream Pitcher Vase works with a single stem or a loose bunch of garden flowers.

Key Features

  • Slim neck that holds stems upright
  • Single handle for easy pouring and carrying
  • Matte cream glaze with subtle speckles

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single vase
  • Colour: Cream
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 34 cm; width: approximately 18 cm
  • Materials: Glazed ceramic

Care Instructions

Hand wash with warm water and mild soap. Dry thoroughly. Refresh water every few days when using with cut flowers.

What's Included

1 ceramic vase

Placement & Usage Notes

Waterproof inside. Not dishwasher or microwave safe. Handle with care, as ceramic can chip.

products.title: Glazed Blue Globe Vase
products.body_html:
A rounded vase decorated with a flowing blue floral pattern. The Fernwork Glazed Blue Globe Vase is a centrepiece on its own, with or without flowers.

Key Features

  • Hand-painted-style blue floral pattern
  • Generous globe shape with a flared blue rim
  • Looks just as good empty as full

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single vase
  • Colour: Cream / Blue
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 44 cm; width: approximately 26 cm
  • Materials: Glazed porcelain

Care Instructions

Hand wash with warm water and mild soap. Avoid abrasive pads. Dry thoroughly before storing.

What's Included

1 porcelain vase

Placement & Usage Notes

Pattern placement varies slightly from piece to piece. Display away from edges and keep out of reach of small children.

products.title: Storm Hurricane Lantern
products.body_html:
A vintage-style hurricane lantern with an aged bronze finish. The Fernwork Storm Hurricane Lantern adds warm, flickering character to porches, tables and shelves.

Key Features

  • Classic hurricane silhouette with a tall carry handle
  • Aged bronze-finish metal with a glass globe
  • Designed as a decorative piece for candles or LED inserts

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single lantern
  • Colour: Aged bronze / Clear glass
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 29 cm (including handle); width: approximately 12 cm
  • Materials: Finished steel and glass

Care Instructions

Dust with a dry cloth and clean the glass with a soft, damp cloth. Keep the metal dry to protect the finish.

What's Included

1 lantern; candle or LED insert not included

Placement & Usage Notes

Decorative use only. Never leave a lit candle unattended, and keep away from anything flammable.

products.title: Oak Candle Lantern
products.body_html:
A sturdy wooden lantern with glass panes and a steel carry handle. The Fernwork Oak Candle Lantern brings a cosy glow to garden tables, patios and quiet corners indoors.

Key Features

  • Timber frame with a warm, natural finish
  • Glass panels let the light spill out softly
  • Steel handle for carrying or hanging

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single lantern
  • Colour: Natural oak / Dark steel
  • Dimensions: Height: approximately 53 cm (including handle); width: approximately 22 cm
  • Materials: Oak-style hardwood frame, glass panes, steel handle

Care Instructions

Wipe the frame with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Clean the glass with a soft cloth. If used outdoors, bring it in during heavy rain.

What's Included

1 lantern; candle not included

Placement & Usage Notes

Decorative use only. Use with a pillar candle or LED candle, and never leave a lit flame unattended.

products.title: Lidded Wicker Basket
products.body_html:
A hand-woven basket with a loose-fitting lid and sturdy little feet. The Fernwork Lidded Wicker Basket keeps throws, toys, linens or garden gloves tidy and looks lovely doing it.

Key Features

  • Tight, even weave in a warm natural tone
  • Removable lid for easy access
  • Raised feet keep the base off damp floors

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single basket with lid
  • Colour: Natural
  • Dimensions: Width: approximately 37 cm; depth: approximately 27 cm; height: approximately 22 cm
  • Materials: Hand-woven natural fibre (rattan-style)

Care Instructions

Dust with a soft brush. Spot clean with a lightly damp cloth and let it dry in the shade. Keep out of prolonged direct sun.

What's Included

1 basket with lid

Placement & Usage Notes

Natural fibre varies in tone from piece to piece. Not intended for heavy loads or wet items.

products.title: Zinc Watering Can
products.body_html:
A small, honest watering can with a long reach. The Fernwork Zinc Watering Can pours gently enough for seedlings and indoor plants, and looks good left out on a shelf.

Key Features

  • Long spout for reaching into dense pots
  • Galvanised zinc finish that weathers beautifully
  • Comfortable handle and balanced pour

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Fernwork
  • Configuration: Single watering can
  • Colour: Galvanised zinc
  • Dimensions: Length: approximately 45 cm; height: approximately 20 cm
  • Materials: Galvanised steel (zinc finish)

Care Instructions

Empty and dry after use to protect the finish. Wipe the outside with a soft cloth. A light patina over time is normal.

What's Included

1 watering can

Placement & Usage Notes

For watering plants only. Do not use for food or drinking water.
